### Work Breakdown Structure

**Backend Development**  
- Design database schema for reviews, ratings, and photos (2 person days)  
- Implement API endpoints for submitting reviews, fetching reviews, and calculating average ratings (4 person days)  
- Build moderation queue functionality (3 person days)  
- Integrate photo storage solution (e.g., AWS S3) (3 person days)  

**Frontend Development**  
- Create UI for leaving reviews (star rating, text, photo upload) (4 person days)  
- Develop UI for displaying reviews and average rating on product pages (3 person days)  
- Implement moderation UI for admin panel (3 person days)  

**Testing & QA**  
- Write unit tests for backend APIs (3 person days)  
- Perform end-to-end testing of review submission and moderation flow (4 person days)  
- Test photo upload and display functionality (2 person days)  

**Deployment & Monitoring**  
- Deploy feature to staging and production environments (2 person days)  
- Set up monitoring for review submission and moderation (2 person days)  

**Documentation & Training**  
- Document API endpoints and moderation process (2 person days)  
- Train support team on moderation workflow (1 person day)  

**Project Management**  
- Sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives (5 person days)  

### Total Estimate  
41 person days  

### Assumptions  
- The company uses a cloud-based infrastructure (e.g., AWS) for photo storage.  
- A pre-existing admin panel is available for moderation UI integration.  
- No significant changes to the existing database schema are required.  
- The holiday season deadline is 6 weeks from the start of development.  
- A team of 3-4 developers will work on this feature concurrently.  
- No major dependencies on third-party services beyond photo storage.
